description: This file defines message structures and related classes for inter-process communication within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It includes definitions for message framing, initialization, setup, and data handling, as well as type definitions for IPC messages.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a data frame with serialization and deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Encapsulates input message data, including methods to set and retrieve message components.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Encapsulates output message data, including methods to add implementations and serialize data.

classes.name: Init
classes.description: Represents initialization data for RPC communication, including methods to set and query message type and related identifiers.

classes.name: Setup
classes.description: Represents setup configuration data for RPC, including implementation, sequence number, proxy stub path, and trace categories.

methods.name: instance_cast
methods.description: Converts an incoming value to an instance_id type.
